title:
Emeritus
Short Courses.
text:
Eduvos is a private higher education institution in South Africa, registered with the DHET as Eduvos (Pty) Ltd (2001/HE07/008). Qualifications are accredited by the CHE/HEQC and registered on the NQF by SAQA. See Eduvos facts, About Eduvos, and programmes. We partnered with Emeritus, a global leader in professional education that offers access to career-accelerating online courses from Ivy League schools and other top-ranked universities worldwide. Together, we’re bridging international expertise with local support to help you elevate your career, shape your future, and drive innovation in your field. Emeritus is a world-renowned provider of professional and executive education, delivering high-impact learning experiences in partnership with over 80 elite institutions.

Operating across 20+ countries with a team of 2,000 global experts, Emeritus was named the #1 EdTech company globally by Time Magazine and listed among the Top 150 most transformational growth companies in digital learning by Global Silicon Valley (GSV). Emeritus courses are designed for busy professionals like you, offering world-class education that fits into your life, not the other way around.

With over 200 courses from top-ranked institutions, you’ll find a course that aligns with your goals, whether you’re stepping into a new role, switching industries, or levelling up your expertise. Gain skills to assess a company’s financial health and value by using real-world data and Excel tools. Discover how AI transforms industries and learn to work alongside data scientists to drive business results.
  Learn to unlock creativity using proven innovation tools and overcome mental blocks to generate new product ideas. Focus your business on fewer, high-impact initiatives to unlock sustainable growth. Sharpen your thinking, research, and decision-making skills to solve complex problems effectively. Use a creative, human-centered approach to problem-solving that drives innovation and results. Master digital tools and content strategies to better connect with customers and boost your marketing results. Discover how to reshape your business model for the digital age, respond to disruption, and lead innovation. Understand how digital platforms like Uber and Airbnb work - and learn to design your own.
  Find your leadership style, build self-awareness, and develop a personal vision for effective leadership. Learn how to evaluate projects, manage risk, and make smarter investment decisions for business growth. Understand and evaluate financial statements to make better business and investment decisions. Learn how to use design thinking to solve problems creatively and create customer-focused products and services. Build the leadership skills to motivate teams, solve problems, and drive meaningful change in organizations. Lead change with confidence using proven organizational models and a clear understanding of internal dynamics. Discover how to build and manage high-performing teams, handle conflict, and lead with clarity.
  Build practical leadership, financial, and decision-making skills to drive team and business success. Build a complete personal sales toolkit—from prospecting to closing—using proven, practical techniques. Understand workplace culture and use relationship networks to get things done more effectively.
  Learn to negotiate with confidence and ethically apply influence in work and leadership situations. Develop your leadership identity, build positive habits, and grow with stakeholder-centered feedback. Improve team dynamics and unlock collaboration with insights from behavioral science and smart team practices. Learn to craft strategies that give your organization an edge and keep it ahead of competitors. Drive growth by embedding innovation into your business strategy using proven tools and frameworks. Learn how to design and execute strategy, align teams, and adapt to business change. Once you’ve chosen your course, completed the simple sign-up process, and made your payment, Eduvos and Emeritus will be in touch with all the details you need to start your learning journey. Once you successfully complete all coursework, you’ll receive a certificate from the university offering the course, co-signed by Emeritus, an influential credential to elevate your career and skill set.

title: Pre-degree Foundation Programme: Commerce And Law
text:
Eduvos is a private higher education institution in South Africa, registered with the DHET as Eduvos (Pty) Ltd (2001/HE07/008). Qualifications are accredited by the CHE/HEQC and registered on the NQF by SAQA. See Eduvos facts, About Eduvos, and programmes. You will develop a theoretical understanding of, and practical skills in, English language and comprehension, numeracy and the use of computers and technology. You will also learn how to study, conduct research and be a successful student. The core subjects are Student Skills, Academic English, Development Studies, and AI Literacy and Digital Skills. You will also complete stream-specific modules (including one elective where applicable) in Social Science, Science, Graphic Design, IT, and Commerce and Law. The programme is designed to offer access to each of our faculties, aligned to the admission requirements for each degree. 
Much of the success of our Pre-Degree Foundation Programme is due to our unique blend of lecture-led learning, Technology Enhanced Learning (TEL), our smaller interactive classes and cutting-edge facilities such as campus resource centres and computer labs. Within this supportive environment, you will also start developing essential skills for life as a student and for the world of work. You will learn how to analyse and solve real problems, apply logic, be innovative, work in teams and communicate effectively. Applicants must hold one of the following:
• National Senior Certificate (NSC) with bachelor’s degree endorsement, Diploma or Higher Certificate pass; 
• National Certificate (Vocational) (NCV) with bachelor’s degree endorsement, Diploma or Higher Certificate pass; 
• A Senior Certificate (SC) with achievements that meet the legislated requirements set for entry into a degree or Higher Certificate; 
• Certificate of evaluation on a minimum NQF Level 4 for a foreign qualification issued by SAQA;
  AND

1. Social Science*

3. title: Higher Certificate in Art and Design
text:
Eduvos is a private higher education institution in South Africa, registered with the DHET as Eduvos (Pty) Ltd (2001/HE07/008). Qualifications are accredited by the CHE/HEQC and registered on the NQF by SAQA. See Eduvos facts, About Eduvos, and programmes. The Higher Certificate (Art and Design) provides a broad foundation in visual communication, graphic design, digital design and creative practice. Students develop introductory theoretical, technical and professional skills through contextual study, practical projects and the use of relevant design software. 
The programme develops creative problem-solving, visual communication, collaboration, project planning and independent working skills. It prepares graduates for junior or assistant-level opportunities in the creative industries or for further study in an appropriate art and design discipline. Applicants must hold one of the following:
• National Senior Certificate (NSC) with bachelor’s degree endorsement, Diploma or Higher Certificate pass;
• National Certificate (Vocational) (NCV) with bachelor’s degree endorsement, Diploma or Higher Certificate pass;

• Completion of a Bachelor’s degree, Diploma, Higher Certificate or equivalent in South Africa;
• Certificate of evaluation on a minimum NQF Level 4 for a foreign qualification issued by SAQA.
• Applicants may also be admitted on the basis of Recognition of Prior Learning, subject to the applicable institutional RPL requirements. Graduates may pursue junior or assistant-level opportunities in graphic design, digital content creation, branding, social media design, advertising production and related creative fields.

Eduvos is a private higher education institution in South Africa, registered with the DHET as Eduvos (Pty) Ltd (2001/HE07/008). Qualifications are accredited by the CHE/HEQC and registered on the NQF by SAQA. See Eduvos facts, About Eduvos, and programmes. The primary purpose of the programme is to provide students with foundational knowledge, practical skills and applied competence in the field of biological science or a related field. This programme provides students with skills which are required in the workplace to improve their overall productivity. In addition to bioscience-related subject knowledge, students are supported to develop graduate attributes that are essential skills to excel both at personal and professional levels. The combination of theory and practice results in well-rounded students who, on successful completion, are prepared to launch careers as laboratory assistants in the biosciences. Importantly, one of the exit-level outcomes is for graduates to be able to demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the key terms, concepts, facts, principles, and theories related to the field of biological science, as well as the specific subject areas of the programme, and to apply this knowledge in practice. The Higher Certificate (Business Management) programme introduces students to the core disciplines of the modern workplace and provides a foundation for employment in the business environment. It also provides an access pathway for students who do not meet the entry requirements for a degree and wish to apply for admission to an Eduvos Bachelor of Commerce programme after successfully completing the Higher Certificate, subject to the applicable admission requirements. 
The programme focuses on the key areas of business management, human resource management and marketing. You will also cover Mathematics for Business, Academic English, AI Literacy and Digital Skills, Employment Relations, Business Communication, Small Business Development and Bookkeeping. Within the curriculum, you will be introduced to topical business subject areas such as the elements of the marketing mix, recruitment, management and leadership, governance and sustainability in business. Through its learning and teaching approach, the programme develops essential workplace capabilities, including problem-solving, critical thinking, teamwork and effective communication. Work Readiness Skills A and B support the development of critical thinking and practical workplace capabilities and enable students to apply knowledge acquired across the programme.

Graphic designers are visual communicators who develop creative concepts and designs to promote or enhance products, services and organisations.  You will develop a broad theoretical foundation and practical experience in various core areas of graphic design such as Communication Design, Digital Design, Drawing, Web Design, Typography and Motion Graphics. title: Master of Laws in Commercial Law
text:
Eduvos is a private higher education institution in South Africa, registered with the DHET as Eduvos (Pty) Ltd (2001/HE07/008). Qualifications are accredited by the CHE/HEQC and registered on the NQF by SAQA. See Eduvos facts, About Eduvos, and programmes. The Master of Laws in Commercial Law – LLM – programme develops specialised professional knowledge and an advanced understanding of commercial law principles, practices and emerging areas. It prepares students to critically analyse the legal implications of commercial transactions, regulatory frameworks and developments affecting commerce and business. Through case studies, simulations and advanced legal research, students apply legal knowledge to complex commercial contexts, evaluate legal risk and develop legally sound, commercially informed responses. 
The curriculum covers areas such as corporate law, international business transactions, banking law and payment instruments, cyber and security law, labour law and tax law.
The programme is relevant to legal practitioners, legal advisors, in-house counsel and other professionals who require advanced commercial law expertise. It culminates in an independently researched dissertation in 
commercial law and provides a foundation for specialist professional practice and further academic study. 
As such, this programme specifically addresses the need for specialist knowledge in various areas of commercial law practice, through a comprehensive curriculum that covers emerging fields such as banking law, letters of credit, demand guarantees, cryptocurrencies, cyber and security law, international business law and cross-border transactions. This specialised knowledge enables students, including attorneys, advocates, legal advisors, in-house legal counsel, and non-legal professionals, to meet the demands of the evolving commercial landscape and contribute effectively to the business sector. Applicants must hold one of the following:
• a recognised Bachelor of Laws – LLB – qualification;
• a relevant Bachelor Honours Degree at NQF Level 8;
• a relevant 480-credit Bachelor’s degree at NQF Level 8;
• a relevant Postgraduate Diploma at NQF Level 8;
• a foreign qualification evaluated by SAQA as comparable to an appropriate South African qualification at NQF Level 8; or
• admission through Recognition of Prior Learning, subject to the applicable institutional RPL requirements. Graduates of the LLM programme may apply their advanced commercial law expertise in areas such as:
• Academia and Legal Research*
• Banking and Financial Services Law
• Commercial and Corporate Legal Advisory Services
• Compliance and Regulatory Affairs
• Corporate Governance
• Cross-Border Transactions and International Trade
• Legal Consulting
• Legal Practice in Commercial Law**
• Risk Management
• Tax, Labour or Cyber Law, depending on the electives completed
• Trade Finance and Commercial Transactions 
*Academic careers may require further qualifications and relevant teaching or research experience.
**Legal practice as an attorney or advocate remains subject to the applicable professional admission requirements. Year 1 - NQF Level 9 (90 Credits)
The programme offers six elective modules, from which students select three. Students complete two electives and Research Methodology in Year 1, followed by one elective and the LLM Dissertation in Year 2. The programme totals 180 credits.

◦ International Business Transactions - 30 credits 
◦ Law of Banking and Instruments of Payment - 30 credits Year 2 - NQF Level 9 (90 Credits)
